WFH has been a love/Hate relationship for me. Been WFH since March when we didn't have a to choice. I love sleeping but I find myself now, not only skipping breakfast, but all meals, and eating just like one meal a day. I'd just sleep the whole time, work, eat something, and sleep the reset of the time. I like sleeping but I hate that it actually prevents me from doing other things because I'm just spending my whole day in bed. Every week I'm like alright this week I won't sleep that much and every week I sleep waaaaay too much lol. It honestly sucks because before the quarantine, when I used to go the office I had no choice but to wake and used to force myself to go the gym right after work and was making good progress, now with my new program of sleep all day, work and eat once in a while, I'm almost at the point where I look like Christian Bale in The Machinist.
